summary: Highway Holdings filed a 6-K disclosing a Nov 4, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement with David Lazar for 1,750,000 Series AA and 1,750,000 Series AAA Preferred Shares at $2.00/share, $7,000,000 aggregate cash, signed and closed simultaneously. Series AA converts into ~19.99% of pre-investment common; both series convert to ~95% fully diluted post-shareholder approval, effecting a change of control. Directors/officers holding ~24.9% will vote in favor; a special meeting is targeted within 90 days. A NewCo spin-off of the legacy manufacturing business and Legacy Holder Dividend accompany the deal. Watch the shareholder-approval vote and conversion mechanics.
